verdict.rationale: Granola documents scheduled transcript auto-deletion with retention periods from 1 day to 1 year, and a way to permanently remove notes on demand. However, the retention setting covers only transcripts (notes are explicitly excluded), recordings are not addressed, and the evidence does not show it as a workspace-wide policy that an IT admin enforces. Missing for 10: admin-enforced workspace-wide retention policy, retention covering recordings and notes, independent corroboration of permanent erasure.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can set retention policies — auto-delete transcripts and recordings on a schedule — and permanently erase data on demand

citations.quote: Granola allows you to automatically delete transcripts after a set period of time. This applies only to transcripts — your notes are not affected and will remain available.
Choose a retention period from the dropdown: 1 day, 1 week, 1 month, 3 months, 6 months, or 1 year
Permanently remove notes or recover accidentally deleted ones.
